home.faq1Q: Does it cost anything for my customers?
home.faq1A: No. It is free for your customers to use TimeFlow to follow projects, approve times, view documentation and communicate about ongoing work. Private customers can also create a free TimeFlow Home account and download the TimeFlow Home app to get full insight into their projects.
home.faq2Q: Is TimeFlow adapted for digital staff registers?
home.faq2A: Yes. TimeFlow supports digital staff registers and can be integrated with approved solutions to meet current legal requirements in the construction and craft industries.
home.faq3Q: Which accounting systems can TimeFlow integrate with?
home.faq3A: Through our financial integrations, TimeFlow can be connected to several of the market's leading accounting and financial systems. Contact us for current information on which integrations are supported.
home.faq4A: Yes. TimeFlow automatically handles ROT/RUT tax deductions and generates accurate invoice documentation for private clients.
home.faq5Q: Is there a binding contract period?
home.faq5A: Yes. Our corporate licenses have a binding period of 3 months. After that, the subscription continues according to the selected billing period.
home.faq6Q: Can I try TimeFlow before deciding?
home.faq6A: Yes. We offer a free 30-day trial period without requiring a credit card. During the trial period you can evaluate the system's features and see how TimeFlow can streamline your business. Please note that access to TimeFlow's quote and lead platform requires an active corporate license.
home.faq7A: Some add-on services are billed separately, for example: BankID signing, SMS dispatch, digital storage, supplier invoice scanning, premium features and selected integrations. All add-ons and prices are shown in our price list.
home.faq8Q: How many users can I have?
home.faq8A: TimeFlow is developed for both sole proprietors and larger organizations. The number of users depends on which license level you choose. You can easily upgrade as your business grows.
home.faq9Q: Does it cost to get new customers via TimeFlow?
home.faq9A: Yes. For jobs acquired via TimeFlow's quote and lead platform, an admin fee from 295 kr per job applies. For certain job types, a 1–3% fee of the quote value may apply. The fee is charged only to the assigned contractor.
home.faq10Q: Is my data secure in TimeFlow?
home.faq10A: Yes. Security and data protection are a central part of TimeFlow. Customer data is stored in Sweden with professional hosting and datacenter providers at a high security level. All communication is encrypted and access to information is governed by access controls. We continuously work with backup, monitoring and security routines to protect your company's information.
home.faq11A: All customer data is stored in Sweden in modern datacenters with high physical and digital security. Through local storage, regular backup and modern security solutions we ensure high availability and safe handling of your company's information.
home.faq12Q: Is TimeFlow suitable for small businesses?
home.faq12A: Absolutely. TimeFlow is developed for everything from sole proprietors to larger organizations with hundreds of users. Many smaller businesses use TimeFlow to reduce administration, invoice faster, get better control over projects and create new business opportunities through our quote and lead platform.
home.faq13Q: What makes TimeFlow different from traditional ERPs?
home.faq13A: TimeFlow combines quotes, projects, time tracking, documentation, finances, mobile apps and customer acquisition in one single platform. Instead of using several different systems, you get a unified workflow from first customer contact to final invoice.

timeflowWork.workDesc: Developed for craftsmen and field staff. With real-time information, digital documentation and AI-based safety inspections, every employee gets the right information at the right time.
timeflowWork.f1D: My orders, my projects, work descriptions, status, priority, customer information, contacts, addresses, map position, materials, attachments, documents and drawings — everything updates in real time. Also works with main projects and sub-projects, e.g. riser replacements where each apartment is its own sub-project with its own customer and its own options.
timeflowWork.f2D: See the entire contract on a property — main project against e.g. a housing association and sub-projects per apartment, premises or member. Report time, change orders, photos, self-inspections and options directly on the right sub-project so that each customer gets correct finances, ROT deductions and documentation.
timeflowWork.f3D: Report work start, stops, breaks, overtime, travel time, machine time and material time directly on order, project or activity. Automatically linked to payroll, projects and invoicing.
timeflowWork.f4D: Register change, additional and outgoing work on site. Document with images, video, notes, customer approval, position, date, time and digital signing.
timeflowWork.f5D: Digital safety inspections for self-inspections, risk analyses, safety rounds, checklists, incidents, accidents, deviations and KMA inspections — everything is documented digitally.
timeflowWork.f6D: AI analyzes performed inspections, identifies work steps, protective equipment, tools, machines, deviations and images — reducing errors and raising quality in the KMA process.
timeflowWork.f7D: Every inspection is linked to GPS position, time, object, project, employee and images. This ensures the inspection was actually performed at the right place.
timeflowWork.f8D: Sign self-inspections, safety rounds, risk assessments, work preparations, KMA inspections, deviations, change orders and deliveries with BankID — legally binding and traceable.
timeflowWork.f9D: Email, SMS and push notifications when inspections are due, safety rounds approach, certificates expire or risk assessments are missing. Escalates to supervisors if verification is missed.
timeflowWork.f10D: Drawings, manuals, work instructions, KMA documents, safety data sheets, agreements, project information, meeting minutes and change documents — always the latest version.
timeflowWork.f11D: Communicate directly with project management. Handle questions, comments, cases, attachments, images and decisions — everything is saved on the project.
timeflowWork.f12D: Digital workplace check-in for employees, visitors and subcontractors. Personnel register, access control and ensuring the right people at the right place.
timeflowWork.f13D: Plan the day’s work with routes, GPS navigation, driving log, trips, vehicles, fuel and mileage — linked directly to the vehicle module.
timeflowWork.f14D: Personal portal for every employee with payslips, vacation balance, working hours, certificates, training, news, documents, policies, company information and whistleblower function.
timeflowWork.secureDesc: SecureCheck™ handles self-inspections, risk analyses, safety rounds, checklists, incidents, accidents, deviations and KMA inspections. The AI verifies images, work steps, protective equipment and machines — and links everything to GPS, time and object.

timeflowWork.m4D: Manage invoices, reminders, debt collection, payment status and accounts receivable directly in the app.
timeflowWork.m5D: Administer purchase orders, suppliers, materials, deliveries and goods receiving — even at the customer.
timeflowWork.m6D: See project status, schedule, budget, forecasts, change orders, documents, resources, risks and staffing. Manage main projects with an unlimited number of sub-projects linked to separate customers — perfect for riser replacements, renovations and property assignments with several clients in the same building.
timeflowWork.m7D: Staffing, attendance, vacation, sick leave, skills, recruitment and payroll basis — collected in one place.
timeflowWork.m8D: Agreements, drawings, decisions, board minutes, KMA and reports — always the latest version, on any device.
timeflowWork.m9D: Send messages, push notifications, SMS and email to the whole company or selected groups.
timeflowWork.m10D: The intelligent business assistant summarizes events, identifies risks and deviations, prioritizes tasks, suggests actions, answers questions about company data and provides decision support in real time.
timeflowWork.robertDesc: AI Robert™ summarizes the most important events of the day, identifies risks and deviations, prioritizes work tasks, suggests actions, answers questions about company data and analyzes finance, projects and sales — for better decisions in real time.
timeflowWork.ctaDesc: With TimeFlow Manager™ and TimeFlow Work™, the whole organization works in the same system, with the same information and in real time. It reduces administration, prevents mistakes, strengthens safety and gives both management and employees better control over the business.

timeflowManager.label: Admin app · TimeFlow Manager™
timeflowManager.heroDesc: TimeFlow Manager™ is the administration side of TimeFlow — built for the trade management, project managers, site managers and supervisors. Get full control over business, production, finance and business support in real time, on mobile, tablet, iPad and computer.
timeflowManager.allModulesDesc: TimeFlow Manager gives you access to the same data as TimeFlow Work, but with governance and administration tools for the entire business.
timeflowManager.m1D: Create, send and follow up quotes. Get notifications when the customer opens, comments or accepts — and convert to order with one click.
timeflowManager.m2D: Manage leads, customers, campaigns, follow-ups and agreements. AI Robert™ prioritizes the hottest leads and reminds about the next activity.
timeflowManager.m3D: Convert approved quotes into orders, allocate resources, plan the start and link materials and change orders directly from the mobile.
timeflowManager.m4D: Digital agreements, signing, versions and templates. Ensure the right documents are always used and that changes are tracked.
timeflowManager.m5D: Full overview of schedule, budget, forecast, change orders, resources, risks and documents. Updated in real time by field staff.
timeflowManager.m6D: Build contracts with main projects and an unlimited number of sub-projects linked to separate customers. Perfect for riser replacements in housing associations, renovations and property assignments — every apartment becomes its own sub-project with its own customer, finances, options, ROT deductions and inspection, while the main project keeps schedule, KMA, personnel register and consolidated reporting together.
timeflowManager.m7D: Calculate projects, create cost estimates and build planning documentation — even at the customer.
timeflowManager.m8D: Purchase orders, suppliers, deliveries, goods receiving and stock status. Linked to projects and invoicing.
timeflowManager.m9D: Overview of vehicles, machines, service, driving logs, trips and operating costs.
timeflowManager.m10D: Access rights, key management, entry and secure access to objects, machines and digital documents.
timeflowManager.m11D: Revenue, profit, cash flow, budget, forecasts and KPIs — updated automatically from projects, time and invoicing.
timeflowManager.m12D: Create, send and follow up invoices, reminders and accounts receivable.
timeflowManager.m13D: Ready-made integration with Autoekonomi (kr 199/month add-on) for bookkeeping, VAT, reports and annual accounts.
timeflowManager.m14D: Forecast cash flow, capacity utilization and profitability based on order backlog, time reports and history.
timeflowManager.m15D: Manage reminders, debt collection claims and payment follow-up — traceable and integrated.
timeflowManager.m16D: Staffing, attendance, vacation, sick leave, skills, certificates, recruitment and payroll basis.
timeflowManager.m17D: Quality, environment and work environment — document inspections, deviations, risks and actions according to industry requirements.
timeflowManager.m18D: Agreement templates, cases, advice and documentation — linked to projects and customers.
timeflowManager.m19D: IT register, devices, software, licenses, logins, codes and support cases per individual.
timeflowManager.m20D: Executive Dashboard, board minutes, cases, KPIs, strategy, reports and whistleblower function.
timeflowManager.compareTitle: Work for the field. Manager for the office.
timeflowManager.compareDesc: Same system, two experiences. TimeFlow Work is made for those who perform the work. TimeFlow Manager is made for those who lead and administer.

timeflowManager.priceDesc: TimeFlow Manager is included in the Standard and PRO licenses for administrators. Start with Start (kr 2,995/month) and add Standard or PRO administrators as needed. The TimeFlow Work app for workers can be added separately.
timeflowManager.ctaTitle: The whole office in one system.
timeflowManager.ctaDesc: With TimeFlow Manager™ and TimeFlow Work™, management and employees work in the same system, with the same information and in real time. Less administration, fewer mistakes and better control.
